title: LLMs reason directly on raw scientific data, matching domain expert models

fields.title: LLMs reason directly on raw scientific data, matching domain expert models
fields.author: Kejun Albert Ying
fields.description: On 54 raw-record benchmarks, seven frontier language models with no tools and no fine-tuning were placed among 1,667 published specialist scores. The best model ranks in the upper half of the specialists on 20 of 48 benchmarks and above all of them on 14.
